# Tulum Properties

> An independent guide to established real estate developers active in Tulum, Mexico — their backgrounds, areas of activity and official websites.

Tulum Properties is an independent editorial directory. It is not a real estate agency or broker, does not sell property and is not affiliated with the companies it profiles.

## Developer profiles
- [Inmobilia](https://www.tulum-properties.com/developers/inmobilia/): A Mérida-based developer of large planned communities whose Tulum presence centres on Tulum 101, a master-planned district of residential, hospitality and mixed-use projects.
- [SIMCA](https://www.tulum-properties.com/developers/simca/): A southeast-Mexico developer with residential, industrial and retail divisions, active in Tulum through condominium projects in Aldea Zamá, La Veleta and the Tulum 101 master plan.
- [TAO México](https://www.tulum-properties.com/developers/tao-mexico/): TAO México is a Riviera Maya-born developer of residential communities, with completed and ongoing projects in Tulum, Akumal and Puerto Aventuras and newer work in Puerto Vallarta and Los Cabos.
- [Grupo R4 Yucatán](https://www.tulum-properties.com/developers/grupo-r4/): A Yucatán Peninsula developer with residential projects in Yucatán and Quintana Roo, including three condominium buildings in Tulum's Aldea Zamá area.
